title: GAR Title 2, Division 4. Procurement Regulations, Chapter 10. Compliance with Federal Requirements
text:
2 GAR - ADMINISTRATION
DIV. 4 - PROCUREMENT REGULATIONS
CHAPTER 10
COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL REQUIREMENTS
§10101. Compliance with Federal Requirements (a).
Federal Funds. Where a procurement involves the
expenditure of federal assistance or contract funds, or
other federal funds as defined by Section 20 of the Organic
Act of Guam, all persons within the Government of Guam
shall comply with such federal law and regulations which
are applicable and which may be in conflict with or may
not be reflected in these Regulations (5 GCA §5501 of the
Guam Procurement Act).
CH. 10 - FEDERAL REQUIREMENTS - 1997 - P. 1
